info.description: The course is designed to develop and sharpen learners' academic and professional writing skills and strategies in English. Each unit guides the student through the structured writing process with plenty of full colour illustrations, examples, and exercises to engage the student and build confidence. This course aims at providing students understanding and skills from writing a sentence to developing a full paragraph.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

materials.materialDescription: Academic writing from paragraph to essay
materials.author: L. A. Rumisek D. E. Zemach

clos.loDetails: Understand and use paragraph structure, the topic sentence, unity and coherence of a paragraph.
Understand process to write and can develop a descriptive paragraph.
Understand process to write and can develop an example paragraph.
Understand process to write and can develop a process paragraph.
Understand process to write and can develop a narrative paragraph
Understand process to write and can develop an opinion paragraph.
